_about: 沉鼎观里的差事 (Hanli, 2026-10-15: 外门在观内走动，下山凭执事堂的令). Chores — the 执事堂's east-wall tags (「杂役，外门也揭得」, 07-第七回) and 周衡's ledger — pay 灵石 (`work: labor`); the night watch and the beasts pay 修为 (`work: cultivation`). The numbers in `grant` are placeholders the economy owner sets (rewards.json's `labor` and `quest` tables). The tags for work below the mountain are in xu.json, each with its `pass`.

who.zh: 执事堂 · 东墙的牌子
who.en: a tag on the stewards' hall's east wall

say.zh: 东墙一块乌木牌：「柴房的柴垛塌了半边，把门堵了。码齐，出得了人。」杂役，外门可揭，工钱照牌。
say.en: An ebony tag on the east wall: "Half the woodpile in the woodshed has come down and blocked the door. Stack it so a body can get out." A chore, outer disciples may take it; paid as the tag says.

done.zh: 柴码齐了，门推得开了。周衡在牌子背面画了个圈：「账平了。」
done.en: The wood is stacked and the door swings again. Zhou Heng draws a circle on the back of the tag: "The books balance."

who.zh: 执事堂 · 东墙的牌子
who.en: a tag on the stewards' hall's east wall

say.zh: 东墙一块乌木牌：「伙房的蒸屉散了架，七块板，拼回一个方屉，明早要用。」杂役，外门可揭。
say.en: An ebony tag on the east wall: "The kitchen's steamer tray has fallen apart — seven boards; fit them back into a square tray, it is wanted at dawn." A chore, outer disciples may take it.

done.zh: 方屉拼上了，严丝合缝。伙房的人掀开看了看，没说话，给你多舀了半勺粥。
done.en: The tray fits together without a gap. The kitchen hand looks it over, says nothing, and ladles you an extra half-scoop of porridge.

say.zh: 周衡把账簿推过来：「九格，横竖斜，一样的数，才叫账平。我眼花了，你替我对一遍。」
say.en: Zhou Heng pushes the ledger across: "Nine squares — across, down and corner to corner the same sum; that is a balanced book. My eyes are tired. Check it for me."

done.zh: 你对完了。周衡拿指头一格一格点过去，点到末了：「账平了。」
done.en: You finish. Zhou Heng runs a finger square by square to the last one: "The books balance."

who.zh: 执事堂 · 东墙的牌子
who.en: a tag on the stewards' hall's east wall

say.zh: 东墙一块乌木牌：「藏经阁下三层的经架受了潮，趁晴天搬到廊下晒。架子挤，得一架一架腾挪。」杂役，外门可揭。
say.en: An ebony tag on the east wall: "The shelves on the scripture hall's lower three floors have taken the damp; carry them out under the eaves while the sun holds. They are packed tight — shift them one at a time." A chore, outer disciples may take it.

done.zh: 经卷一行一行摊在廊下，晒着太阳，一股旧纸的味道。
done.en: The scrolls lie in rows under the eaves in the sun, smelling of old paper.

say.zh: 周衡蹲在药园墙根，看着一个新拱开的洞：「后山崖顶下来的野猪。赶走它，园里少祸害一片。巡夜的事，记你一功。」
say.en: Zhou Heng crouches by the herb-garden wall, looking at a fresh hole rooted under it: "Boars, down off the cliff top. Drive it off and the garden loses that much less. Night-watch work — it goes down to your credit."

done.zh: 那头野猪拖着獠牙逃回了崖顶。周衡在巡夜簿上记了一笔。
done.en: The boar flees back up to the cliff top, tusks and all. Zhou Heng makes a note in the night-watch book.
